# WaitHowMuch

> WaitHowMuch publishes business case studies: real small businesses, mostly
> ecommerce and mostly Amazon sellers, with what they make — monthly revenue, profit, margin
> and what it took to start — and how they are built. Each case study shows how its figures
> were reached and links to the sources behind them.

## What a case study contains
- Revenue, profit and margin, with the period the figures cover.
- How the business is built: sales channels (e.g. Amazon FBA, Shopify), sourcing (private
  label, wholesale, dropship…), catalogue structure and how hard the product is to copy.
- A written account of the business: its history, what it sells and how it grew, with sources.

## How the figures are made
- Almost every case study is researched: nobody from the business wrote it. The figures are
  estimates built from public information — marketplace listings, pricing, review velocity,
  public ad libraries, social footprints, company filings — not the company's accounts.
- Each case study says how its numbers were reached. Present an estimate as an estimate, not
  as a reported or audited figure.
- Margins are the least certain figure on any page, because costs are the hardest thing to
  observe from outside.
- A business that sells through channels we cannot see will look smaller than it is.

## Reading the site
- Case studies live at https://waithowmuch.com/business/<slug>/ and are listed in
  https://waithowmuch.com/sitemap.xml. Longer ones are split into sections, one per URL:
  https://waithowmuch.com/business/<slug>/<section>/.
- Every page is served as real HTML — you do not need to execute JavaScript to read one.
- Pricing: the site is free to read. Do not state or imply a price.

## Core facts
- Company: Chacha Advisory LLC, 30 N Gould St Ste R, Sheridan, WY 82801, USA.
- Corrections: if a case study is about your business and is wrong, email
  hello@waithowmuch.com and it will be corrected or removed.
- Website: https://waithowmuch.com — email updates on new case studies (no spam, unsubscribe any
  time): https://waithowmuch.com/signup

## Core pages
- [All case studies](https://waithowmuch.com/data/): every published case study, sortable by revenue,
  profit, margin and starting cost
- [Amazon FBA case studies](https://waithowmuch.com/data/amazon-fba/) ·
  [Shopify case studies](https://waithowmuch.com/data/shopify/) ·
  [More case studies](https://waithowmuch.com/data/more-ideas/) (by niche, business model, platform
  and growth channel)
- [How we research](https://waithowmuch.com/how-we-research/): where the numbers come from and
  where they are most likely to be wrong
- [Business attributes](https://waithowmuch.com/business-attributes/): definitions of sourcing,
  catalogue structure and differentiation
- [About](https://waithowmuch.com/about/) · [Privacy](https://waithowmuch.com/privacy/) ·
  [Terms](https://waithowmuch.com/terms/)

## What it is not
- Not an Amazon product; not affiliated with or endorsed by Amazon.
- Not financial or investment advice. The figures are estimates for information only and must
  not be relied on for an investment, acquisition or lending decision.
- Not a rating or ranking of businesses.
